title: Pencil with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- pencil body -->
  <rect x='38' y='18' width='24' height='56' rx='2' fill='#FFD447'/>
  <!-- pencil highlight stripe -->
  <rect x='42' y='18' width='5' height='56' fill='#FFE98A'/>
  <!-- pencil shadow stripe -->
  <rect x='56' y='18' width='4' height='56' fill='#E8B830'/>
  <!-- wood cone -->
  <polygon points='38,74 62,74 50,92' fill='#F5C99A'/>
  <!-- wood cone shading -->
  <polygon points='50,74 62,74 50,92' fill='#DBA97A'/>
  <!-- graphite tip -->
  <polygon points='45,85 55,85 50,93' fill='#5A6B8C'/>
  <!-- metal ferrule -->
  <rect x='38' y='10' width='24' height='8' rx='1' fill='#C8D0E0'/>
  <rect x='38' y='12' width='24' height='2' fill='#E8EEF8'/>
  <!-- eraser -->
  <rect x='38' y='3' width='24' height='8' rx='4' fill='#FF8FA0'/>
  <!-- eraser highlight -->
  <rect x='42' y='4' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#FFB8C4'/>
  <!-- face - eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='38' r='3' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='38' r='3' fill='#2A2A4A'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='37' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='37' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 46 Q50 54 56 46' stroke='#2A2A4A' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FF9B7A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='45' r='3' fill='#FF9B7A' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- little arms waving -->
  <path d='M38 52 Q30 48 28 40' stroke='#E8B830' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 52 Q70 48 72 40' stroke='#E8B830' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
